subject.title: feat(desktop): integrate native title bar controls

question: Should ClickClack desktop switch to the integrated native title-bar layout by default whenever the renderer capability marker is present?
rationale: This is a user-visible desktop shell direction across macOS, Windows, and Linux; the implementation is bounded and proof-backed, but product acceptance is still a maintainer choice.

options.title: Accept after changelog cleanup
options.body: Merge the integrated titlebar as the default for capability-marked renderers once the release-owned CHANGELOG.md edit is removed.

options.title: Require an opt-in path
options.body: Ask for a setting or flag if maintainers want existing desktop chrome to remain the default until more platform feedback arrives.

options.title: Defer the desktop chrome change
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it if maintainers do not want native titlebar integration in core yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after changelog cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge the integrated titlebar as the default for capability-marked renderers once the release-owned CHANGELOG.md edit is removed.

likelyOwner.reason: The desktop shell and affected chat layout history point most strongly to steipete as the area owner for this UX decision.
